title: Hijacked on Tubi: Everything You Need to Know
subtitle: One wrong ride and everything a father loves is suddenly on the line.
intro:
The rideshare thriller has arrived at exactly the right moment. We all get in the car. We all hand over a little trust to a stranger with a star rating and a profile photo. Hijacked takes that everyday transaction and twists it into something you won't shake off easily.

This is a movie about a father who will not stop. Not when the odds are wrong, not when the situation keeps getting worse. That kind of singular, desperate love is the engine here, and it runs hot from the first scene.

Chris Stokes has built a career on films that move fast and hit hard, and Hijacked is exactly that kind of ride. Tight, mean, and personal. The influencer angle adds a layer that feels ripped straight from right now, the idea that someone's whole life is public until the moment it really, terrifyingly isn't.

items.name: Tremayne Norris
items.bio: Norris carries the weight of the whole film as the father at the center of the chase. He's not playing a superhero, he's playing a man running on fear and love, and that specific combination is what makes every decision he makes feel real and urgent.

items.name: Chrissy Stokes
items.bio: As the influencer daughter caught in the middle of this nightmare, Stokes brings a believability that keeps the stakes grounded. She's not just a reason for the plot to happen, she's a full person trying to survive, and that distinction matters enormously for a film like this.

items.name: Ken Lawson
items.bio: Lawson brings an unpredictable energy to his role that keeps you genuinely unsettled. The best thrillers need someone you can't read, and Lawson delivers that quality, you're never quite sure what the next move looks like, which is exactly where this film needs you.

items.name: Lateria Hope
items.bio: Hope adds emotional texture to a film that could easily run on pure adrenaline. Her presence reminds you that everyone caught in this situation has their own reason to get out alive, and that reminder makes the tension land harder every single time.

items.question: Who is in the cast?
items.answer: Tremayne Norris, Chrissy Stokes, Ken Lawson, Lateria Hope, Jessica Jarrell, Don Wallace

whyWatch.body: If you watch thrillers for the feeling of your pulse doing something it shouldn't, this one delivers. It's built for people who want their Friday night to have some teeth, a film that respects your appetite for suspense and doesn't let up once it finds its grip.
